greeting: Hello! 👋 Welcome to liv.inn. How can I help you today?
fallback: I can help you with rooms, facilities, location, dining, and contacting our team. Please select an option below.

main.message: What would you like to know?

rooms.message:
liv.inn features **25 Double Bed Rooms** across 5 floors (5 rooms per floor for quiet privacy), each with tranquil nature views.

🛏️ **Double Bed Room** — 200 sq. ft., comfortable double bed (queen size 180 cm), attached en-suite bathroom with 24/7 hot water, individual AC, Smart TV, High-Speed Wi-Fi, work desk, and scenic nature views.

👥 **Occupancy**: 2 Adults + 1 Extra Guest (Extra bed available on request).

🍳 **In-Room Dining**: Freshly prepared meals delivered directly to your room from our in-house cloud kitchen.

📋 *Rates and live availability are confirmed directly upon enquiry.*
